_meta.purpose: Inputs and parameter choices for an LGAR-Py reproduction of Widmer (2024). Every value is either copied or derived from the MSc thesis. Sources are explicit; placeholder values (where we'll iterate) are marked TODO.
_meta.thesis: Widmer, N. (2024). Quantifying subsurface water movement in a reforestation initiative through geophysical monitoring. MSc thesis, ETH Zurich. notes/Masters_thesis_Neomi_Widmer_18-115-303-1.pdf

site.regional_geology: Cuddalore sandstone (Mid-Pliocene, iron-rich arkosic) with patches of Manaveli clay in topographical lows
site.vegetation: Tropical dry evergreen forest; successional environment A (bushland: Acacia holosericea, Aristidia setacea, Chrysopogon fulvus); successional environment B (woodland, Acacia auriculiformis up to 30 m) bordering site

climate.source: Widmer §2.3.1 (p. 7); Meteo Atlas 2024, Climate-Data.org 2024, Gassama et al. 2012

PET_method.reason_not_Penman_Monteith: ATMOS-14 weather station does not record wind speed
PET_method.input_source_in_our_data: logger 19570, port 5 (ATMOS-14), variable air_temp, aggregate to daily min/max/mean

soil_classification.sample_positions: electrode positions 1, 5, 10 along all ER lines, both swale and control plots
soil_classification.method: EMS SOIL 2000 sedimentation, Stokes' Law (clay/silt/sand mass fractions)
soil_classification.field_class_project_soil_scientist: Sandy Clay Loam (also per Roeschli et al. 2021)
soil_classification.rationale_for_compromise: Significant influence of soil class on model parameters; AEMS samples and field judgement diverged; Loam covers both
soil_classification.source: Widmer §3.5.1 (p. 27); EMS SOIL 2000; Roeschli et al. 2021

soil_hydraulic_parameters._comment: van Genuchten + Mualem. Parameter ranges sourced from Widmer Tables 4 and 5 (p. 28); category = Loam.

theta_r_volumetric._comment: Widmer uses observed minimum VWC at 10 cm as a proxy for residual water content θ_r. Lower bound is the observed minimum across all 10-cm sensors.

theta_r_at_40cm_observed._comment: Observed VWC range at 40 cm (different physical layer; not used as θ_r proxy in Widmer)

theta_s_total_porosity._comment: Total porosity computed as theta_s = 1 - rho_b/rho_s. Bulk density rho_b (g/cm3) from oven-dry (105 degC) cylindrical samples per Poeplau et al. 2017. Particle density rho_s gravimetric per Santos et al. 2022. 2 soil profiles analyzed.
theta_s_total_porosity.source: Widmer Table 4 (p. 28), §3.5.1 (p. 28), Eq. 17; Poeplau et al. 2017; Santos et al. 2022

K_s_saturated_hydraulic_conductivity._comment_calibration: Widmer's developer-suggested approach later: log-space sampling for K_s during calibration

alpha_vG_air_entry_inverse._comment: Air-entry pressure parameter. Very low values (cf. typical 'loam' ~ 0.04 /cm) hint at fine-textured / clay-rich loam at our site (consistent with the kaolinite-rich Ferralsol). Log-space calibration suggested by LGAR-Py developer.

n_vG._comment: n_vG values near 1.1-1.2 are characteristic of fine-textured soils (clay loam / silt clay). Far from coarse loam (n>1.5).

m_vG._comment: Constrained by n_vG via the Mualem closure

l_pore_connectivity._comment: Mualem pore-connectivity parameter; default value used by Widmer per LGAR-Py / La Follette 2023
l_pore_connectivity.source: Widmer §3.5 (p. 27), Eq. 14; Mualem 1976; La Follette et al. 2023

AET_reduction._comment: Capillary head at which AET = 0.5 * PET. AET demand is taken from the topmost wetting front per LGAR-Py.
AET_reduction.ponded_head_rationale: Site is sloping (5%); surface ponding for any duration is not expected

model.package_paper: La Follette et al. 2023, Water Resources Research, 10.1029/2022WR033742
code_repos_known: https://github.com/NOAA-OWP/LGAR-C  (current maintained version, C — same algorithm; used inside LASAM)
model.version_to_use: Original LGAR-Py from the publication snapshot (HydroShare). Rationale: reproducibility with Widmer. The Python version is no longer actively maintained per upstream; the C version (LGAR-C / LASAM) is the current maintained implementation but we accept the unmaintained Python version for the comparison.

precipitation_mm_per_h.validity: intact through 2025-06-22 22:15; silent thereafter (see memory rain_gauge_failure)

PET_mm_per_h.source: Hargreaves-Samani daily PET divided into hourly demand uniformly across daylight hours (Widmer treats PET on daily scale, plots as bars in Fig. 12)
PET_mm_per_h._comment: Widmer's plots show DAILY precipitation and PET (Fig. 12, p. 21). The LGAR model itself runs sub-daily.

soil_column._comment: Widmer does NOT explicitly describe column depth or layering in the methodology; the model is run as a single layer per the LGAR-Py demo. We will follow that.
soil_column.single_layer_thickness_m: TODO  (Widmer does not state explicitly; LGAR-Py demo column ~2 m)

calibration_history_widmer._comment: Documenting what Widmer tried so we don't repeat dead ends.
calibration_history_widmer.step_1_initial: Run with mean parameter values from Tables 4-5 — poor fit
calibration_history_widmer.step_2_random_sampling: 10000 parameter sets randomly drawn within (min, max) ranges — poor fit
calibration_history_widmer.step_4_log_sampling_pyswarms: Per LGAR-Py developer advice: log-space sampling of K_s and alpha, vary initial capillary head, minimize via PySwarms (particle-swarm) — no improvement
calibration_history_widmer.step_5_forcing_smoothing: Redistribute 5-min rainfall into 1-hour intervals to broaden peaks — limited improvement
calibration_history_widmer.step_6_AET_PET_ratio_tweaks: Manual modifications of AET/PET ratio — no improvement
observed_failure_modes: Modeled VWC peaks too narrow vs observation
Modeled VWC returns to baseline too fast
Cannot reproduce slow VWC buildup at 0.4 m depth
calibration_history_widmer.conclusion: Widmer presents one event with the chosen parameters and discusses implications; quantitative inversion was abandoned

sensor_mapping._comment: Widmer's Table 6 (p. 32) uses sensor numbers 1-16. Our SMS01-SMS16 numbering MAY OR MAY NOT match. Verify before any quantitative comparison.
sensor_mapping._action: Cross-check against our Metadata.xlsx Serials tab before any comparison run

data_window_widmer.rain_event_filter: events commencing with initial precipitation rate of 12 mm/h

Initial condition: prior VWC profile at start of run. Widmer used 2024-05-28; we can extend earlier from logger commissioning
Whether to model swale and control as different parameter sets, or shared parameters with different forcing/BC
Vegetation/root water uptake: only AET reduction (psi_50 = 0.75 m) is used; no Feddes root distribution per layer
